description.en: Plugins maintained in the dsh-sandbox platform.
description.zh: 由 dsh-sandbox 平台维护与托管的插件。

description.en: A file manager page in the left sidebar: browse any server directory with breadcrumbs and a path bar, upload, download (including ZIP of a directory or selection), preview text and images, create folders, rename, and delete.
description.zh: 左侧栏里的服务器文件管理页面：面包屑与路径直达，上传、下载（含目录或选区的 ZIP 打包）、文本与图片预览、新建文件夹、重命名、删除。
